messages:
sam: Noticed prod-eu warm pool failed to reach target for ~15m after the firewall baseline rollout. New nodes stayed Pending.
ops-bot: deploy: firewall/eu-baseline applied by tara at 2026-03-23T01:12Z (change-id ch_20260323_fw_eu_7) :information_source:
sam: Init log from provisioner: ```2026-03-23T01:16:03Z keystore-proxy: decrypt error: AccessDenied: \"KMS Grant missing for caller\"\ncallstack: node-init -> keystore-proxy -> privatelink (eu-keystore) -> kms```
nisha: That rollout tightened outbound egress to the privatelink subnet. We narrowed it to the control plane CIDR to reduce noisy telemetry.
mike: The rule removed the shared NAT egress path for ephemeral instances. keystore traffic was accidentally excluded — caused grant fetches to fail.
tara: Immediate options: 1) add fw exception for keystore privatelink cidr 10.2.48.0/28 (temporary) 2) restore NAT egress for the ephem tag 3) divert provisioning to fallback region (costy).
sam: Prefer (1) to limit blast radius. Need TTL, audit note, and a monitor to ensure decrypts succeed before rollout continues.
security-bot: Exception policy: require justification, TTL <= 4h, audit entry with change-id, and notification to compliance.
nisha: I'll open a policy exception: adding allow 10.2.48.0/28 -> 10.2.48.5:443 for service keystore-proxy, TTL 2h, tag=keystore-emerg-20260323. Ops will schedule rollback.
mike: Added quick alert: metric keystore.decrypt_rate{region=\"eu\"} and gpu.pool.warm_target_gap. Alert on decrypt_rate < 0.9 or warm_target_gap > 0.
sam: Ran checks from bastion: ```$ curl -vS https://keystore-eu.privatelink.redwood.internal/health HTTP/1.1
> TLS handshake ok
< 200 OK
# but client then saw KMS grant access denied when requesting key id arn:aws:kms:eu:...:key/1234```
tara: Created policy-change ticket #2592 (expires 2026-03-23T05:10Z). ops-bot: ticket #2592 created by nisha.
security-bot: Reminder: capture KMS grant logs, include kms:key-id in incident doc, and route to audit pipeline.
mike: Note on tradeoffs: fallback region (usw2) would avoid egress exceptions but adds latency and cross-region egress costs ~ $0.12/token estimate for onboarding traffic spike. Per-service privatelink endpoints per region cost approx $600/mo + maintenance. NAT egress increase estimated $300/mo for eu region.
nisha: I'll draft a short ops memo comparing: (A) NAT allowance (lower ops cost, higher monthly egress) vs (B) per-service privatelink (higher capex, better isolation).
sam: Owners: postmortem = @sam, runtime fix = @mike, security sign-off = @tara.
ops-bot: rollback scheduled at 2026-03-23T03:10Z unless ticket extended.
sam: After we stabilize, we should add a firewall pipeline unit test that validates keystore grant flow pre-rollout. Also add a canary that provisions 2 nodes and verifies keystore.decrypt success before scaling.
security-bot: After-action: attach audit log export to ticket and run compliance scan.
sam: Thanks all. I'll monitor decrypt metric and warm pool count. :thumbsup:
